tools.name: set_servo_angle
tools.description:
Move the physical SG90 to an approximate angle (-45..+45 degrees, center = 0) and hold it.

External 5V supply must be on and grounds connected. This physically moves
hardware. -45/0/+45 correspond to 1000/1500/2000us. No measured-angle feedback.
PWM keeps running after this call and after the client disconnects.

tools.name: get_servo_status
tools.description: Get last commanded position and software PWM state; does not move hardware.

tools.name: stop_servo
tools.description: Stop PWM. Does NOT switch off the external supply or guarantee mechanical braking.
